claims.claim: The official Python documentation provides distinct setup guidance for Windows, macOS, and Unix platforms.
Running python3 --version asks the selected python3 interpreter to report its version.
sys.executable identifies the absolute path of the interpreter currently running a program.
The standard-library venv module creates lightweight virtual environments, each with its own Python binary and site-packages directory.
A program can test whether it is in a venv by comparing sys.prefix and sys.base_prefix.
Activating a virtual environment changes the shell PATH so its commands are found first, but activation is not required when the environment's interpreter path is used directly.
